changes.comment: Align agents[].config with claude-code and antigravity: add optional non-empty model and effort fields (emitting TOML-quoted -c model and -c model_reasoning_effort ahead of extra_args), remove sandbox_mode and initialize_timeout_ms from config (tolerated and ignored under R21; sandbox defers to native ~/.codex/config.toml or extra_args and handshake timeout stays an internal 10s constant), and drop the removed config constants from public exports.
